summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mahmoud Shakibi, a retired Iranian football player born in 1922 in Tehran. It states that he played for the Iran national football team and for Shahin F.C. during the 1940s and 1950s.
one_line: Mahmoud Shakibi was a retired Iranian footballer born in Tehran in 1922 who played for Iran and Shahin F.C.
key_facts: Mahmoud Shakibi was born in 1922 in Tehran, Iran.
Mahmoud Shakibi is described as a retired Iranian football player.
Mahmoud Shakibi played for the Iran national football team.
Mahmoud Shakibi played for Shahin F.C.
Mahmoud Shakibi's playing career is placed in the 1940s and 1950s.
